explanation: The crowd came mainly for its gunpowder. Only seven prisoners were inside, and the fortress was soon demolished; some of its stones were carved into souvenir models.

claims.text: A crowd stormed the Bastille, a Paris fortress used as a royal prison, on 14 July 1789.
The Conciergerie, the Temple and the Louvre were not stormed on 14 July 1789.
The crowd that stormed the Bastille wanted its stores of gunpowder.
Only seven prisoners were held in the Bastille when it was stormed.
The Bastille was demolished soon afterwards, and some of its stones were carved into models of the fortress.
